title: Drug proceeds already held in crypto by a broker
summary: A broker sends drug proceeds, already held in crypto, to the launderer's wallet in 1 to 3 transfers. A case follows one slice of the proceeds.

basis.note: The report says that cartels had already placed drug money into crypto before the cash-out service received it. A case follows one slice, so its size is assumed, and a pattern may set a smaller slice.

parties.label: the broker that holds the proceeds

steps.say: The broker sends the proceeds in a stablecoin to the launderer's wallet.

basis.note: The report says that cartel clients had already placed drug money into crypto. The stablecoin on the Tron chain, the broker as sender, the count of 1 to 3 transfers and the waits are assumed.
